name: COUPPCD
description: COUPPCD returns the date of the coupon payment immediately before the settlement date for a bond.
tldr: Calculates the previous coupon date before the settlement date.

parameters.name: frequency
parameters.description: Number of coupon payments per year (1, 2, or 4).

basicExample.description: Previous coupon date for a semi-annual bond
basicExample.explanation: Returns the date of the coupon payment before settlement. Format the cell as a date.

advancedExamples.title: Format the result as a date
advancedExamples.explanation: Uses TEXT to display the date serial number as a string.

howItWorks: COUPPCD uses the maturity date and frequency to calculate the coupon schedule and returns the most recent coupon date before settlement.

howToSteps.name: Calculate
howToSteps.text: Press Enter to get the result.

limitations: Basis affects date calculations in some edge cases.

commonErrors.cause: Result is a date serial number.
commonErrors.fix: Format the cell as a date.

googleSheetsEquivalent.description: COUPPCD works identically in Google Sheets.
googleSheetsEquivalent.notes: Same syntax and behavior as Excel.

faq.question: What is the difference between COUPPCD and COUPNCD?
faq.answer: COUPPCD returns the previous coupon date. COUPNCD returns the next coupon date.

faq.question: How do I display the result of COUPPCD?
faq.answer: Format the cell as a date or use TEXT.
